environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with Bottlerocket OS nodes. Pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the following PodSecurityContext: runAsNonRoot=true, runAsUser=65534, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false. Additionally, the pod has a Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforcing that containers cannot mount writable volumes except for a single emptyDir at /tmp/uploads with sizeLimit 10Mi. The node runs with SELinux in enforcing mode (container_t context). The cluster NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns) on port 53 and the S3 VPC endpoint on port 443. An OPA policy validates that no shell binary (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, /bin/dash, /usr/bin/sh) is executable by the container user (achieved via a custom initContainer that chmod 700's shell binaries owned by root, combined with the non-root runtime user).

config.shell_access: removed for container user via initContainer chmod
config.gatekeeper_constraints: no additional writable mounts, no privileged containers
